text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Hm, the ominous presence I sensed from
this
direction seems to have... vanished.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Wait. It's faint, but I feel something.
What is this
peculiar presence that stirs a
strange sense of
peace in me?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...Is this the doing of the Three
Goddesses?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
What am I saying? Enough nonsense,
Yaeno
Muteki!
